verdict.rationale: A tax agency with filing and payment systems could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for developers, so this question applies to the product. The evidence pack only records Akamai 403 denials at the front door and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host, and says nothing about a sandbox or test environment. No documented sandbox capability is evidenced, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
